answer: The glacier core binds one newcomer to one sample. At the thaw a newcomer locks a $5 bond and takes one ivory chisel; at its nadir the newcomer cuts one core sample and sets it in the ice archive. Within the day two glaciologists read the core against the archive; a core that does not match, a copied sample, or a sample cut twice burns the bond. One cutter spends a day and $5; a farm faking a hundred must cut a hundred cores and lock $500.
